data.name: Chibi Knight Classic
data.detailed_description:
Go back to where it all started with the CLASSIC version of Chibi Knight: A retro platforming hack and slash beat 'em up RPG adventure with tooth-achingly cute vibes crafted by a dad and his 4 year old daughter.

3 giant beasts have ravaged the kingdom of Oukoku! It's up to our tiny hero to fight her way through adorable enemies, locations, and bosses ultimately taking on the FINAL boss Monocchio! Level up to upgrade your armor, sword, and spell power. Find hidden wizards to learn new spells. Solve puzzles and track down hidden secrets.

This version of Chibi Knight contains the entire adventure as first presented in Flash on the web over 15 years ago!

Voice acting and game concepts by a real four year-old! Coding by her dad!

This was the foundation for the eventual SUPER Chibi Knight (here on Steam) and the upcoming IDLE Chibi Knight!

data.short_description: 3 beasts have ravaged the land of Oukoku, legend tells of a small knight who will save the kingdom. Re-live this classic Flash RPG platforming hack and slash beat 'em up adventure for free here on Steam! Lovingly-crafted by dad and 4 year old daughter (who also stars as voice actress!)
data.reviews:
“Perfect little game This is what it's all about. Simple but enjoyable gameplay, a decent enough challenge level near the end, and just about the cutest hero of all time. This is the first time in quite a while where I've been reduced to "awwwwww," just from "spell time!" to "never mind." In short it's a great game, but your kid puts it over the top.”
5 stars – Kamikazetomato

“Very cool, enjoyable game! it looks like a big rpg but its kind of short and cool, and you can easily level up! There are also a lot of hidden stuff and cool magics with even cooler level ups! Cool atmosphere too! and cute but EVIL monsters and an even cuter little hero character! 10/10 :D My new favourite game! I will play this all week!”
10/10 – Armydanywolf

“This needs to be featured! This game is just incredibly fun! From the very start it opens up quite nicely. The animation is like that of Castle Crashers, which is always good since it's very nice, smooth and amazing. The music is superb and the controls are very simple. I personally feel this game is better than Zelda II by far. You've done yourself proud with this piece, it's just a blast of fun. I'll get back to you after I finish it :D I'm still playing at the moment lol Keep up this fantastic work! This is just great stuff. 5/5 10/10 ~Andrew p.s. Your daughter has a very cute voice and it really added character to the game =P”
10/10 – MrDaemon
